# Pré-traitement 
```{r}
base <- read.csv("balanced_can_md.csv")
table <- read_xlsx("Table_can_md.xlsx")
str(base)

#sélection de la plage de données
base <- base %>%
  filter(Date >= as.Date("1990-01-01"),
         Date <= as.Date("2026-06-01"))

var_can<- table %>% 
  filter(Region=="CAN") |> 
  pull(Variable)

var_can <- var_can[var_can %in% names(base)]

base <- base |>
  select(Date, all_of(var_can))

str(base)

```

# I. Analyses exploratoire et descriptive
## Analyse des valeurs manquante 

```{r, warning=FALSE}
gg_miss_upset(base)
```
5 variables avec des valeurs manquantes, soit 69 valeurs manquantes présentent au même endroit pour chacunes d'entre elles. 

on supprime les 5 variables car il y a un risque de multicolinéaroté avec les nouvelles variables active.

```{r}
base <- base |>
  dplyr::select(
    -CRED_T_discontinued,
    -CRED_HOUS_discontinued,
    -CRED_MORT_discontinued,
    -CRED_CONS_discontinued,
    -CRE_BUS_discontinued
  )
```

## Graphique de la variable à expliquer 

```{r}
# Création de la ts
yy <- ts(base$hstart_CAN_new, start=c(1990,01), frequency=12)

# Graphique de la série
plot.ts(yy, main = "Évolution du taux de croissance des mises en chantier au Canada (1990-2026)", ylab = "Taux de croissance", xlab = "Année")

moyenne <- mean(yy, na.rm = TRUE)
abline(h = moyenne, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```
On observe visuellement que la série oscille autour d'une moyenne proche de zéro, avec une variance qui semble globalement stable (caractéristique d'une série stationnarisée par transformation), tout en affichant quelques pics de volatilité plus marqués, notamment autour de certaines périodes économiques ou récentes (comme en 2020-2023).

### Stationarité de la variable à expliquer 
```{r}
adf.test(yy)
kpss.test(yy)
```

## Corrélation entre les variables à explicatives et la variable à expliquer, et entre les variables explicatives

Spearman  car relation potentiellement non linéaire c'est mieux 

### Corrélation entre les variables explicatives et la variable à expliquer


```{r}
  seuil_cor <- 0.1
  
  # Calculer la corrélation de chaque variable explicative avec hstart_CAN_new
  cor_dep <- sapply(base %>% select(-c(Date, hstart_CAN_new)), function(x) {
    cor(x, base$hstart_CAN_new, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  })
  
  # Filtrer selon le seuil et trier
  cor_dep_filtre <- cor_dep[abs(cor_dep) >= seuil_cor]
  cor_dep_filtre <- sort(cor_dep_filtre)
  
  # Palette de couleurs
  pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#D95F02", "#F7F7F7", "#2B5C8F"))
  cols <- pal(100)[as.numeric(cut(cor_dep_filtre, breaks = 100))]
  
  # Ajuster la marge de gauche pour les noms longs
  par(mar = c(4, 14, 4, 2)) 
  
  # Graphique en barres horizontales
  barplot(cor_dep_filtre, horiz = TRUE, las = 1, col = cols,
          main = paste0("Variables corrélées avec hstart_CAN_new (|r| ≥ ", seuil_cor, ")"),
          xlab = "Coefficient de corrélation", cex.names = 0.75)
  
  abline(v = 0, col = "grey40", lty = 2)
```

### Corrélation entre les variables explicatives


```{r}
seuil <- 0.9

matrice_cor <- base |>
  select(-c(Date,hstart_CAN_new )) |>
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs",method = "spearman")
diag(matrice_cor) <- NA

vars_forte_co <- apply(matrice_cor, 1, function(x) any(abs(x) > seuil, na.rm = TRUE))
matrice_filtre <- matrice_cor[vars_forte_co, vars_forte_co]

corrplot(matrice_filtre, method = "circle", type = "upper", diag = FALSE, tl.cex = 0.7)
```


# II. Sélection des variables

## 5) Régressions pénalisées : Ridge, Lasso, Elastic-Net, SCAD et Adaptive Lasso

```{r}
registerDoParallel(cores = 4)
training_dlbase <- base
data.frame(training_dlbase)

# x et y standardisés
y <- data.frame(training_dlbase) |>
  select(hstart_CAN_new) |>
  scale(center = T, scale = T) |>
  as.matrix()

x <- data.frame(training_dlbase) |>
  select (-hstart_CAN_new, -Date) |>
  scale(center = T, scale = T) |>
  as.matrix()
```

### Ridge

```{r}
# Ridge regression
set.seed(1)

lambdas_to_try <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 100)

ridge_cv <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0, lambda = lambdas_to_try, standardize = T, nfolds = 10) 
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
plot(ridge_cv,)

lambda_cv_ridge <- ridge_cv$lambda.min
lambda_cv_ridge

# Evaluation du modèle avec lambda_min
model_cv_ridge <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0, lambda = lambda_cv_ridge, standardize = T)
summary(model_cv_ridge)

model_cv_ridge$beta

# Erreur de validation croisee
ridge_cv_mse <- min(ridge_cv$cvm)   # equivalent a ridge_cv$cvm[ridge_cv$lambda == lambda_cv]
ridge_cv_mse

# R2 in-sample du modele final
y_hat <- predict(model_cv_ridge, newx = x)
r2_in_sample_ridge <- 1 - sum((y - y_hat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
r2_in_sample_ridge

# AIC
# Prédictions au lambda optimal
y_hat_ridge <- as.vector(
  predict(model_cv_ridge, newx = x, s = "lambda.min")
)
# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS_ridge <- sum((y - y_hat_ridge)^2)
# Nombre d'observations et de variables
n <- length(y)
p <- ncol(x)
# AIC simplifié (approximation utilisant p + 1 paramètres)
AIC_ridge <- n * log(RSS_ridge / n) + 2 * (p + 1)

# Tableau recapitulatif pour le ridge 
resultats_ridge <- data.frame(
  methode      = "ridge",
  lambda       = lambda_cv_ridge,
  nb_variables = sum(model_cv_ridge$beta != 0),
  cv_mse       = ridge_cv_mse,
  r2_in_sample = r2_in_sample_ridge,
  AIC          = AIC_ridge
)
resultats_ridge

```

### Lasso

```{r}
# LASSO regression
set.seed(1)	

lambdas_to_try <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 100)
# recherche du lambda
lasso_cv <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, lambda = lambdas_to_try, standardize = T, nfolds = 10) 
plot(lasso_cv)

lambda_cv_lasso <- lasso_cv$lambda.min
lambda_cv_lasso

# modele avec bon lambda
model_cv_lasso <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, lambda = lambda_cv_lasso, standardize = T)

model_cv_lasso$beta

# variables retenues
which(! coef(model_cv_lasso) == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)

# Alternative : affiche directement les noms de variables
# avec leur coefficient, au lieu de simples indices de ligne/colonne
coef(model_cv_lasso)[coef(model_cv_lasso)[, 1] != 0, , drop = FALSE]

# Erreur de validation croisee
lasso_cv_mse <- min(lasso_cv$cvm)   # equivalent a lasso_cv$cvm[lasso_cv$lambda == lambda_cv]
lasso_cv_mse

# R2 in-sample du modele final
y_hat <- predict(model_cv_lasso, newx = x)
r2_in_sample_lasso <- 1 - sum((y - y_hat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
r2_in_sample_lasso

# AIC
# Prédictions au lambda optimal
pred <- as.vector(
  predict(model_cv_lasso, newx = x, s = "lambda.min")
)
# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS <- sum((y - pred)^2)
# Nombre de coefficients non nuls, intercept exclu
k <- sum(as.vector(
  coef(model_cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min")[-1]
) != 0)
# AIC approximatif
n <- length(y)
AIC_lasso <- n * log(RSS / n) + 2 * (k + 1)

# Tableau recapitulatif pour lasso 
resultats_lasso <- data.frame(
  methode      = "Lasso",
  lambda       = lambda_cv_lasso,
  nb_variables = sum(model_cv_lasso$beta != 0),
  cv_mse       = lasso_cv_mse,
  r2_in_sample = r2_in_sample_lasso,
  AIC    = AIC_lasso
)
resultats_lasso

```


### Elastic-Net, 
#### Fixed 

```{r}
# Elastic-Net regression with alpha = 0.5
set.seed(1)

lambdas_to_try <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 100)
en_cv <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0.5, lambda = lambdas_to_try, standardize = T, nfolds = 10) 

plot(en_cv)#meilleur lambda
lambda_cv_en <- en_cv$lambda.min
lambda_cv_en

# Evaluation du modèle
model_cv_en <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0.5, lambda = lambda_cv_en, standardize = T)

model_cv_en$beta

# variables retenues
which(! coef(model_cv_en) == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)

# Alternative : affiche directement les noms de variables
# avec leur coefficient, au lieu de simples indices de ligne/colonne
coef(model_cv_en)[coef(model_cv_en)[, 1] != 0, , drop = FALSE]

# Erreur de validation croisee
en_cv_mse <- min(en_cv$cvm) 
en_cv_mse

# R2 in-sample du modele final
y_hat <- predict(model_cv_en, newx = x)
r2_in_sample_en <- 1 - sum((y - y_hat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
r2_in_sample_en

# AIC
# Prédictions au lambda optimal
pred_en <- as.vector(
  predict(model_cv_en, newx = x, s = "lambda.min")
)
# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS_en <- sum((y - pred_en)^2)
# Nombre de coefficients non nuls, hors intercept
k_en <- sum(as.vector(
  coef(model_cv_en, s = "lambda.min")[-1]
) != 0)
# Calcul de l'AIC approximatif
n <- length(y)
AIC_en <- n * log(RSS_en / n) + 2 * (k_en + 1)

# Tableau recapitulatif pour EN
resultats_en_fixed <- data.frame(
  methode      = "EN, fixed",
  lambda       = lambda_cv_en,
  nb_variables = sum(model_cv_en$beta != 0),
  cv_mse       = en_cv_mse,
  r2_in_sample = r2_in_sample_en,
  AIC          = AIC_en
)
resultats_en_fixed

```


#### Grid search 

```{r}
# Elastic-Net avec recherche d'alpha
set.seed(1)	
en_min <- NULL
lambdas_to_try <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 100)
alphalist <- seq(0.1,by=0.1)
elasticnet <- lapply(alphalist, function(a){
cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha=a, lambda = lambdas_to_try, standardize = T, nfolds = 10)
})
for (i in 1:9) {
print(min(elasticnet[[i]]$cvm))
en_min <- c(en_min, min(elasticnet[[i]]$cvm))
}
elasticnet_cvm <- min(en_min)
elasticnet_cvm

en_cv <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = elasticnet_cvm, lambda = lambdas_to_try, standardize = T, nfolds = 10) 
plot(en_cv)

#meilleur lambda
lambda_cv <- en_cv$lambda.min
lambda_cv

# modele final
model_cv <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = elasticnet_cvm, lambda = lambda_cv, standardize = T)

model_cv$beta

# variables retenues
which(! coef(model_cv) == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)  

# Alternative
coef(model_cv)[coef(model_cv)[, 1] != 0, , drop = FALSE]

# Erreur de validation croisee 
en_cv_mse <- min(en_cv$cvm) 
en_cv_mse

# R2 in-sample du modele final
y_hat <- predict(model_cv, newx = x)
r2_in_sample <- 1 - sum((y - y_hat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
r2_in_sample

# AIC
# Prédictions au lambda optimal
pred_eng <- as.vector(
  predict(model_cv, newx = x, s = "lambda.min")
)
# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS_eng <- sum((y - pred_eng)^2)
# Nombre de coefficients non nuls, hors intercept
k_eng <- sum(as.vector(
  coef(model_cv, s = "lambda.min")[-1]
) != 0)
# Calcul de l'AIC approximatif
n <- length(y)
AIC_eng <- n * log(RSS_eng / n) + 2 * (k_eng + 1)

# Tableau recapitulatif pour EN
resultats_en_gird <- data.frame(
  methode      = "EN Grid",
  lambda       = lambda_cv,
  nb_variables = sum(model_cv$beta != 0),
  cv_mse       = en_cv_mse,
  r2_in_sample = r2_in_sample,
  AIC          = AIC_eng
)
resultats_en_gird


```

décomposition du lambda
```{r}
# Paramètres retenus par le modèle Elastic Net
alpha_f <- 0.5
lambda_f <- lambda_cv_en

alpha_g <- elasticnet_cvm
lambda_g <- lambda_cv

# Décomposition de la pénalisation
lambda_L1_f <- lambda_f * alpha_f
lambda_L1_g <- lambda_g * alpha_g

lambda_L1_f
lambda_L1_g
```




### SCAD

```{r}
# SCAD
set.seed(1)

fit_SCAD=ncvreg(x, y, penalty = c("SCAD"))
summary(fit_SCAD, lambda=0.10)
plot(fit_SCAD)

# Validation croisé pour le meilleur lambda 
cvfit_SCAD=cv.ncvreg(x, y, penalty = c("SCAD"))
plot(cvfit_SCAD)

# meilleur lambda 
lambda_SCAD <- cvfit_SCAD$lambda.min
lambda_SCAD

#Modele finale 
SCAD_Final=ncvreg(x, y, lambda=lambda_SCAD, penalty = "SCAD")
SCAD_Final$beta

which(! coef(SCAD_Final) == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)

# Alternative
coef(SCAD_Final)[coef(SCAD_Final) != 0]

# Erreur de validation croisee
scad_cv_mse <- cvfit_SCAD$cve[cvfit_SCAD$min]
scad_cv_mse

# R2 in-sample du modele final
y_hat_scad <- predict(SCAD_Final, X = x)
r2_in_sample_scad <- 1 - sum((y - y_hat_scad)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
r2_in_sample_scad

# AIC
# Prédictions du modèle SCAD final
y_hat_scad <- as.vector(
  predict(SCAD_Final, X = x)
)
# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS_scad <- sum((y - y_hat_scad)^2)
# Nombre de coefficients non nuls, hors intercept
beta_scad <- coef(SCAD_Final)
k_scad <- sum(beta_scad[-1] != 0)
# Calcul de l'AIC approximatif
n <- length(y)
AIC_scad <- n * log(RSS_scad / n) + 2 * (k_scad + 1)

# Tableau recapitulatif pour SCAD
resultats_scad <- data.frame(
  methode      = "SCAD",
  lambda       = lambda_SCAD,
  nb_variables = sum(SCAD_Final$beta != 0) - 1,   # -1 pour exclure l'intercept
  cv_mse       = scad_cv_mse,
  r2_in_sample = r2_in_sample_scad,
  AIC          = AIC_scad
)
resultats_scad


```

### Adaptive Lasso

#### Adaptive Lasso - Ridge

```{r}
# Adaptive Lasso avec ridge en première étape
set.seed(1)	

# definition des poids
lambdas_to_try <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 100)
ridge_cv <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0, lambda = lambdas_to_try, standardize = T, nfolds = 10) 
lambda_cv <- ridge_cv$lambda.min
model_cv <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0, lambda = lambda_cv, standardize = T)
coef_ridge <- predict(model_cv,type="coef",s=lambda_cv)

# poids avec gamma = 0.5
gamma = 0.5
w0 <- 1/(abs(coef_ridge) + (1/length(y)))
poids.ridge <- w0^(gamma)
poids.ridge <- poids.ridge[2:nrow(poids.ridge),]
poids.ridge <- Matrix(poids.ridge)

# Adaptive LASSO
fit_adalasso_r <- glmnet(x, y, penalty.factor =poids.ridge)
fit_cv_adalasso_r <- cv.glmnet(x, y,penalty.factor=poids.ridge)
plot(fit_cv_adalasso_r)

# meilleur lambda
lambda_cv_adalasso_r <- fit_cv_adalasso_r$lambda.min
lambda_cv_adalasso_r

# Modele final
model_cv_adalasso_r <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, lambda = lambda_cv_adalasso_r, standardize = T)

model_cv_adalasso_r$beta

# variables retenues
which(! coef(model_cv_adalasso_r) == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)

# Alternative
coef(model_cv_adalasso_r)[coef(model_cv_adalasso_r)[, 1] != 0, , drop = FALSE]

# Erreur de validation croisee 
alasso_cv_mse <- min(fit_cv_adalasso_r$cvm)
alasso_cv_mse

# R2 in-sample du modele final
y_hat <- predict(model_cv_adalasso_r, newx = x)
r2_in_sample_lr <- 1 - sum((y - y_hat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
r2_in_sample_lr

# AIC
# Prédictions du modèle Adaptive Lasso
y_hat_alasso <- as.vector(
  predict(model_cv_adalasso_r, newx = x)
)
# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS_alasso <- sum((y - y_hat_alasso)^2)
# Coefficients du modèle
beta_alasso <- coef(model_cv_adalasso_r)
# Nombre de coefficients non nuls, hors intercept
k_alasso <- sum(as.vector(beta_alasso)[-1] != 0)
# AIC approximatif
n <- length(y)
AIC_alasso_r <- n * log(RSS_alasso / n) + 2 * (k_alasso + 1)

# Tableau recapitulatif pour alasso 
resultats_alasso_ridge <- data.frame(
  methode      = "aLasso-Ridge",
  lambda       = lambda_cv_adalasso_r,
  nb_variables = sum(model_cv_adalasso_r$beta != 0),
  cv_mse       = alasso_cv_mse,
  r2_in_sample = r2_in_sample_lr,
  AIC          = AIC_alasso_r
)
resultats_alasso_ridge

```

#### Adaptive Lasso - Lasso

```{r}

poids.lasso <- Matrix(poids.lasso)

# Adaptive LASSO

plot(fit_cv_adalasso_lasso)

lambda_cv_adalasso_lasso

model_cv_adalasso_lasso$beta

# variables retenues
which(! coef(model_cv_adalasso_lasso) == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)


# Erreur de validation croisee
alasso_lasso_cv_mse_lasso <- min(fit_cv_adalasso_lasso$cvm) 
alasso_lasso_cv_mse_lasso

# R2 in-sample du modele final
y_hat <- predict(model_cv_adalasso_lasso, newx = x)
r2_in_sample_lasso <- 1 - sum((y - y_hat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
r2_in_sample_lasso

# AIC
# Prédictions du modèle Adaptive Lasso
y_hat_alasso <- as.vector(
  predict(model_cv_adalasso_lasso, newx = x)
)
# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS_alasso <- sum((y - y_hat_alasso)^2)
# Coefficients du modèle
beta_alasso <- coef(model_cv_adalasso_lasso)
# Nombre de coefficients non nuls, hors intercept
k_alasso <- sum(as.vector(beta_alasso)[-1] != 0)
# AIC approximatif
n <- length(y)
AIC_alasso <- n * log(RSS_alasso / n) + 2 * (k_alasso + 1)

# Tableau recapitulatif pour alasso 
resultats_alasso_lasso <- data.frame(
  methode      = "aLasso-Lasso",
  lambda       = lambda_cv_adalasso_lasso,
  nb_variables = sum(model_cv_adalasso_lasso$beta != 0),
  cv_mse       = alasso_lasso_cv_mse_lasso,
  r2_in_sample = r2_in_sample_lasso,
  AIC          = AIC_alasso
)
resultats_alasso_lasso
```

## 7) Comparaison sous forme de tableau des variables sélectionnées par les différentes approches en reportant ces variables sélectionnées estimées par les MCO

### Tableau des hyperparamètres

```{r}
hyperparam_wide <- data.frame(
  Paramètre = c("Lambda", "Alpha"),
  Ridge = c(round(lambda_cv_ridge, 5), 0),
  Lasso = c(round(lambda_cv_lasso, 5), 1),
  `Elastic-Net` = c(round(lambda_cv_en, 5), 0.5),
  SCAD = c(round(lambda_SCAD, 5), NA),
  `Adaptive Lasso Lasso` = c(round(lambda_cv_adalasso_lasso, 5), 1),
  `Adaptive Lasso Ridge` = c(round(lambda_cv_adalasso_r, 5), 1))

hyperparam_wide |>
  kable(
    caption = "Hyperparamètres sélectionnés par validation croisée pour chaque méthode pénalisée",
    digits = 5
  ) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center", bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Tableau des coefficients des Beta + MCO

```{r}
# Estimation du modèle MCO sur toutes les données
lm <- lm(y ~ x)
summary_mco <- summary(lm)

# Prédictions sur l'échantillon complet
y_hat_MCO <- as.vector(predict(lm))

# Somme des carrés des résidus
RSS_MCO <- sum((y - y_hat_MCO)^2)

# AIC
n <- length(y)
k <- length(coef(lm))
AIC_MCO <- n * log(RSS_MCO / n) + 2 * k

# MSE in-sample
MSE_MCO <- mean((y - y_hat_MCO)^2)

# Validation croisée à 10 plis pour le MCO
set.seed(1)

folds <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = n))
mse_cv_mco <- numeric(10)

for (i in 1:10) {
  train <- which(folds != i)
  test  <- which(folds == i)

  train_data <- data.frame(
    y = as.vector(y[train]),
    as.data.frame(x[train, , drop = FALSE])
  )

  test_data <- as.data.frame(
    x[test, , drop = FALSE]
  )

  model_mco_cv <- lm(y ~ ., data = train_data)
  y_pred <- predict(model_mco_cv, newdata = test_data)

  mse_cv_mco[i] <- mean((y[test] - y_pred)^2)
}

MSE_CV_MCO <- mean(mse_cv_mco)

# Affichage des résultats
AIC_MCO
MSE_CV_MCO
```

## Vérification hyp MCO 

```{r}
# Homoscédacticité 
bptest(lm)
# Autocorrélation des résidus, test de Breusch-Godfrey
bgtest(lm, order = 12)
# test RESET de Ramsey
resettest(lm, power = 2:3, type = "fitted")
```

```{r}
# Extraction des coefficients et p-values avec retrait de l'intercept
coefs_mco <- summary_mco$coefficients[-1, , drop = FALSE]
var_names <- colnames(x)
rownames(coefs_mco) <- var_names


# Préparation du tableau MCO uniquement pour les coefficients significatifs
mco_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coefs_mco),
  Coefficient = coefs_mco[, "Estimate"],
  p_value = coefs_mco[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
) |>
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    `Coeff. (MCO)` = ifelse(
      p_value < 0.10,
      paste0(round(Coefficient, 4), Significance),
      ""
    )
  ) |>
  select(Variable, `Coeff. (MCO)`)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Fonction pour extraire les coefficients des modèles glmnet
# ---------------------------------------------------------

get_beta_glmnet <- function(model, var_names, lambda){
  
  beta <- as.vector(coef(model, s = lambda))
  
  # Retrait de l'intercept
  beta <- beta[-1]
  
  names(beta) <- var_names
  
  return(beta)
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extraction des coefficients des différentes méthodes
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Ridge
beta_ridge <- as.vector(
  coef(ridge_cv, s = "lambda.min")
)[-1]

names(beta_ridge) <- var_names


# Lasso
beta_lasso <- as.vector(
  coef(lasso_cv, s = "lambda.min")
)[-1]

names(beta_lasso) <- var_names


beta_en_fixed <- as.vector(model_cv_en$beta)
names(beta_en_fixed) <- var_names


beta_en_grid <- as.vector(model_cv$beta)
names(beta_en_grid) <- var_names


# Adaptive Lasso - Lasso
beta_adalasso <- get_beta_glmnet(
  model_cv_adalasso_lasso,
  var_names,
  lambda = fit_cv_adalasso_lasso$lambda.min
)


# Adaptive Lasso - Ridge
beta_adalasso_r <- get_beta_glmnet(
  model_cv_adalasso_r,
  var_names,
  lambda = fit_cv_adalasso_r$lambda.min
)


# SCAD
beta_scad <- as.vector(
  SCAD_Final$beta[-1]
)

names(beta_scad) <- var_names


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Création du tableau complet
# ---------------------------------------------------------

compar_tab <- data.frame(
  
  Variable = var_names,
  
  `MCO` = mco_df$`Coeff. (MCO)`[
    match(var_names, mco_df$Variable)
  ],
  
  Ridge = beta_ridge,
  
  Lasso = beta_lasso,
  
  `EN, fixed` = beta_en_fixed,
  
  `EN, Grid` = beta_en_grid,
  
  SCAD = beta_scad,
  
  `Adaptive Lasso (Lasso)` = beta_adalasso,
  
  `Adaptive Lasso (Ridge)` = beta_adalasso_r,
  
  check.names = FALSE
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Mise en forme des coefficients
# ---------------------------------------------------------

compar_tab <- compar_tab |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        Ridge,
        Lasso,
        `EN, fixed`,
        `EN, Grid`,
        SCAD,
        `Adaptive Lasso (Lasso)`,
        `Adaptive Lasso (Ridge)`
      ),
      ~ ifelse(
        . == 0,
        "",
        sprintf("%.4f", .)
      )
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Affichage du tableau
# ---------------------------------------------------------

compar_tab |>
  kable(
    caption = "Comparaison des coefficients estimés par les différentes méthodes pénalisées (avec significativité MCO au seuil de 10%)",
    align = "lcccccccc"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export du tableau vers Excel
# ---------------------------------------------------------

write_xlsx(
  compar_tab,
  path = "comparaison_coefficients_modeles.xlsx"
)
```

# Tableau 

```{r}
# Estimation du modèle MCO
lm <- lm(y ~ x)
summary_mco <- summary(lm)

# Extraction des coefficients et p-values avec retrait de l'intercept
coefs_mco <- summary_mco$coefficients[-1, , drop = FALSE]
var_names <- colnames(x)
rownames(coefs_mco) <- var_names

# Préparation du tableau MCO uniquement pour les coefficients significatifs
mco_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coefs_mco),
  Coefficient = coefs_mco[, "Estimate"],
  p_value = coefs_mco[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
) |>
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    `Coeff. (MCO)` = ifelse(
      p_value < 0.10,
      paste0(round(Coefficient, 4), Significance),
      ""
    )
  ) |>
  select(Variable, `Coeff. (MCO)`)

# Extraction des coefficients des méthodes pénalisées
get_beta_glmnet <- function(model, var_names, lambda){
  beta <- as.vector(coef(model, s = lambda))
  beta <- beta[-1]
  names(beta) <- var_names
  return(beta)
}

beta_ridge <- get_beta_glmnet(model_cv_ridge, var_names, lambda = ridge_cv$lambda.min)

beta_lasso <- get_beta_glmnet(model_cv_lasso, var_names, lambda = lasso_cv$lambda.min)

beta_en    <- get_beta_glmnet(model_cv_en, var_names, lambda = en_cv$lambda.min)

beta_adalasso <- get_beta_glmnet(model_cv_adalasso_lasso, var_names, lambda = fit_cv_adalasso_lasso$lambda.min)

beta_adalasso_r <- get_beta_glmnet(model_cv_adalasso_r, var_names, lambda = fit_cv_adalasso_r$lambda.min)

beta_scad <- as.vector(SCAD_Final$beta[-1])
names(beta_scad) <- var_names

# Tableau complet
compar_tab <- data.frame(
  Variable = var_names,
  `MCO` = mco_df$`Coeff. (MCO)`[match(var_names, mco_df$Variable)],
  Ridge = round(beta_ridge, 4),
  Lasso = round(beta_lasso, 4),
  `Elastic Net` = round(beta_en, 4),
  SCAD = round(beta_scad, 4),
  `Adaptive Lasso (Lasso)` = round(beta_adalasso, 4),
  `Adaptive Lasso (Ridge)` = round(beta_adalasso_r, 4),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Filtrage : ne garder que les variables sélectionnées par AU MOINS UNE méthode autre que Ridge
compar_tab_filtered <- compar_tab |>
  filter(
    (`Lasso` != 0) |
    (`Elastic Net` != 0) |
    (`SCAD` != 0) |
    (`Adaptive Lasso (Lasso)` != 0) |
    (`Adaptive Lasso (Ridge)` != 0)
  )

# Optionnel : remplacer les 0 restants par vide pour lisibilité
compar_tab_filtered <- compar_tab_filtered |>
  mutate(across(-Variable, ~ ifelse(. == 0, "", .)))

# Affichage du tableau final
compar_tab_filtered |>
  kable(
    caption = "Comparaison des coefficients estimés par différentes méthodes pénalisées (variables sélectionnées par au moins une méthode autre que Ridge)",
    digits = 4
  ) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center", bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```
